subject: Social Media
title: Dark Patterns
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Dark Patterns.

hook.text: You try to delete your account. The button is gray, tiny, buried in settings. Signing up took one click.

buildup.text: Harry Brignull coined 'dark patterns'—design tricks that manipulate users into unintended actions.

discovery.text: Roach motels, trick questions, forced continuity—each pattern exploits a cognitive weakness by design.

twist.text: Amazon's cancellation flow had 6 pages of guilt trips. The EU forced them to simplify it. Design was the weapon.

climax.text: Dark patterns work because friction is invisible. Users blame themselves: 'I should have read the terms.'

punchline.text: Good design helps you choose. Dark design chooses for you.

quiz.question: What are dark patterns?
options: Design tricks that manipulate user behavior
